title: 第13章 给孙悟空普及一下《劳动法》
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: “别闹。”叶凛把那根能捅破天的金箍棒往旁边拨了拨。“这是工作场所，禁止携带大型管制刀具和违规建材入内。”孙悟空愣住了。那双火眼金睛眨巴了两下这凡人说什么？违规建材？这可是如意金箍棒！是大禹治水留下的神珍铁！是一万三千五百斤的定海神针！“你这厮……”孙悟空收回金箍棒，挠了挠猴腮，一脸的不可思议。“你不怕死？”叶凛慢吞吞地从兜里掏出一把从系统那免费领的瓜子。“嗑吗？”叶凛递过去一把。孙悟空下意识地看了一眼，刚想伸手。“不想吃算了。”叶凛收回手，自已嗑了一颗。“怕死啊，谁不怕死。”叶凛一边嗑，一边含糊不清地说道。“但我更怕扣钱。”孙悟空：“？”这猴子自从出世以来，听过怕雷劈的，听过怕火烧的，甚至听过怕老婆的。唯独没听过怕扣钱的。钱是个什么东西？能吃吗？吃了能长生吗？“什么钱？比命还重要？”孙悟空把金箍棒往肩上一扛，身子前倾，那张雷公脸几乎贴到了叶凛鼻子上。“当然重要。”叶凛往后仰了仰，嫌弃地挥了挥手。“猴先生，麻烦保持社交距离，你有口臭。”孙悟空大怒，龇牙咧嘴就要发作。“停！”叶凛把手里那个印着“替天行道”的大茶缸往桌子上一顿。“这里是蟠桃园安保岗，我是这里的临时负责人。”“根据劳动法……哦不对，根据甲方要求，无证入园，后果自负。”孙悟空被这一套一套的词儿整蒙了。他眼珠子转了转，嘿嘿一笑。“俺老孙便是天庭册封的齐天大圣！这就是证！”说着，他指了指自已头上威风凛凛的凤翅紫金冠。“这园子，俺老孙想进就进，想出就出，谁敢拦我？”叶凛翻了个白眼。他拿起那支圆珠笔，翻开面前的小本子。“齐天大圣是吧？行，我查查。”“嗯……没有。”叶凛把本子一合。“今天的访客名单里没有这号人物。”“只有七仙女预定今晚要来摘桃子。”“至于你……”叶凛上下打量了一下这只金灿灿的猴子。“不在受邀之列。”“你是自已走，还是我报二郎神？”听到“二郎神”三个字，孙悟空的眼角抽搐了一下。倒不是怕那个三只眼。主要是那家伙带着条狗，打起来太烦人。“哇呀呀呀！”孙悟空被气乐了。他在原地蹦了三尺高，金箍棒把地面砸得火星四溅。“你这凡人，好生无礼！”“俺老孙今日非要进去吃个痛快！我看你能奈我何！”说罢，孙悟空抡起金箍棒，对着叶凛面前那道无形的空气墙就是一顿乱砸。轰！轰！轰！每一棒都带着万钧之力。整个南天门都在颤抖。远处的流云被震散，附近的仙鹤被吓得掉毛。但叶凛面前那道看不见的屏障，却连一丝涟漪都没有泛起。系统出品，必属精品。概念级防御，只要叶凛不松口，别说是孙悟空。就是如来佛祖来了，也得在门口乖乖填表。叶凛坐在屏障后面，淡定地喝着枸杞水。甚至还嫌吵，从兜里掏出两个棉花球塞进了耳朵里。砸了足足一刻钟。孙悟空累得气喘吁吁。他拄着金箍棒，弯着腰，一双眼睛死死盯着那个坐在小马扎上的凡人。太邪门了。这凡人身上一点法力波动都没有，但这道屏障却硬得像那老君的炼丹炉。“喂！”孙悟空喊了一声。叶凛没反应，还在那儿低头看本子。孙悟空深吸一口气，运足了丹田之气，大吼一声：“喂！！！”叶凛这才慢悠悠地拔出耳塞。“干嘛？砸累了？累了就回去歇着，别挡着我晒太阳。”孙悟空感觉自已的肺都要气炸了。他堂堂美猴王，什么时候受过这种委屈？打又打不进去，骂又骂不过。关键是这小子那副“死猪不怕开水烫”的架势，简直比那凌霄殿上的玉帝老儿还让人火大。“你到底想怎样？”孙悟空咬着牙，从牙缝里挤出这句话。“我想怎样？”叶凛放下茶缸，一脸无辜地摊开手。“猴先生，你这话说的。”“我也很难做啊。”“我就是一个临时工，一个月拿着几千块的死工资……哦不对，一百点血汗钱。”“还得看人脸色，还得防着被投诉。”“你这一棒子要是真砸进来了，桃子丢了是小事，我这饭碗砸了是大事。”叶凛叹了口气，语气变得语重心长。“大家都是出来混口饭吃的，何必互相为难呢？”“你看你，穿得……威风凛凛的，一看就是大领导。”“为了几个桃子，跟我们这种底层保安过不去，传出去好听吗？”“明天天庭头条：齐天大圣欺凌弱小，殴打临时工致残。”“这名声，还要不要了？”孙悟空愣住了。他眨巴着眼睛，挠了挠头上的金毛。这凡人说的……好像有点道理？他现在可是齐天大圣，是有身份的神仙。要是真把这凡人打死了，或者硬闯进去，确实有点掉价。而且这小子一口一个“大领导”，听着还挺顺耳。“那……俺老孙就吃不到桃子了？”孙悟空有点不甘心。那桃子的香味直往鼻子里钻，勾得他馋虫都快爬出来了。“也不是不行。”叶凛话锋一转。孙悟空眼睛一亮，把耳朵凑了过来。“只要手续齐全，我这就放行。”叶凛从怀里掏出一张皱皱巴巴的纸，那是他刚才无聊画的“入园申请表”。“去凌霄殿，找玉帝盖个章。”“或者找王母娘娘签个字。”“实在不行，你让太白金星那个老好人给你写个条子也行。”“只要有条子，我立马开门，甚至还给你带路，帮你挑最大的摘。”叶凛拍着胸脯保证。孙悟空的脸瞬间垮了下来。找玉帝？找王母？他要是能拉下这个脸，还至于偷偷摸摸来这儿？“你这是在消遣俺老孙！”孙悟空把金箍棒往地上一摔。叶凛一脸正气：“这就是规矩！这就是流程！”“没有规矩，不成方圆。”“要是谁都像你这样刷脸进，那这天庭还不乱套了？”“我这是在维护天庭的法治建设，是在为三界的和平稳定做贡献！”叶凛越说越激动，唾沫星子都喷到了屏障上。“你看看我！”他指着自已胳膊上那个歪歪扭扭的红袖箍。“我是谁？我是光荣的蟠桃园保安！”“我的职责就是把好这道门！”“哪怕你是齐天大圣，哪怕你是天王老子，没有条子，就是不行！”这一番话，掷地有声。铿锵有力。把孙悟空都给听愣了。他看着那个瘦弱的凡人，坐在那个破旧的小马扎上，背挺得笔直，一脸的视死如归。甚至还有点……悲壮？这凡人，有点意思。虽然啰嗦了点，虽然迂腐了点。但这股子愣劲儿，倒是有几分他当年的影子。孙悟空眼中的凶光慢慢散去。他把金箍棒变回绣花针大小，塞回耳朵里。然后。他一屁股坐在了叶凛对面的地上。学着叶凛的样子，翘起了二郎腿。“行。”孙悟空抓了抓脸，露出一副无赖相。“你有理。”“俺老孙不进去了。”“我就坐在这儿。”“我倒要看看，你这凡人能守到什么时候。”孙悟空随手从地上拔了一根草，叼在嘴里，一双火眼金睛饶有兴致地盯着叶凛。两人对视了不到一分钟，天性活泼的孙悟空就坐不住了：“咱们聊聊？”“聊什么？”叶凛警惕地护住自已的瓜子。“聊聊你刚才说的那个……劳动法？”孙悟空嘿嘿一笑。“还有，你刚才写什么呢？给俺老孙看看。”
content_en: "Don't make trouble." Ye Lin moved the golden cudgel that could pierce the sky aside."This is a workplace. It is forbidden to bring in large controlled knives and illegal building materials." Sun Wukong was stunned.Those blazing golden eyes blinked twice. What did this mortal say?Illegal building materials?This is the Ruyi Golden Cudgel!It is the sacred iron left by Dayu to control the floods!It’s a 13,500 kilogram Dinghai Shenzhen!"You guy..." Sun Wukong took back the golden cudgel and scratched the monkey's cheek, with a look of disbelief on his face."Aren't you afraid of death?" Ye Lin slowly took out a handful of melon seeds he received for free from the system from his pocket."Would you like it?" Ye Lin handed over a handful.Sun Wukong glanced subconsciously and was about to reach out."If you don't want to eat it, forget it." Ye Lin took back his hand and took one himself."Afraid of death, who is not afraid of death." Ye Lin said vaguely while taking a sip."But I'm more afraid of deducting money." Sun Wukong: "?" Since the monkey was born, he has heard of people who are afraid of lightning, people who are afraid of fire, and even people who are afraid of his wife.The only thing I have never heard of is that they are afraid of having their money deducted.What is money?Can it be eaten?Can you live forever if you eat it?"What money? More important than life?" Sun Wukong put the golden cudgel on his shoulder and leaned forward, with his thunderous face almost touching Ye Lin's nose."Of course it's important." Ye Lin leaned back and waved his hand in disgust."Mr. Monkey, please keep social distance, you have bad breath." Sun Wukong was furious, baring his teeth and about to have an attack."Stop!" Ye Lin put the big teapot with the words "For Heaven's Way" printed on it on the table."This is the Pantaoyuan security post, and I am the temporary person in charge here." "According to the labor law... Oh no, according to Party A's requirements, if you enter the park without a certificate, you will be responsible for the consequences." Sun Wukong was confused by these words.He rolled his eyes and smiled."My old grandson is the Monkey King, the Great Sage conferred by heaven! This is the proof!" As he spoke, he pointed to the majestic purple gold crown with phoenix wings on his head."I, Sun, can come in and out of this garden whenever I want. Who dares to stop me?" Ye Lin rolled his eyes.He picked up the ballpoint pen and opened the small book in front of him."Monkey King, right? OK, I'll check." "Hmm... No." Ye Lin closed the notebook."There is no such person in today's visitor list." "Only the Seven Fairies are scheduled to come to pick peaches tonight." "As for you..." Ye Lin looked up and down at the golden monkey."Not among those invited." "Are you leaving on your own, or should I repay Erlang Shen?" Upon hearing the words "Er Lang Shen", the corners of Sun Wukong's eyes twitched.It's not that I'm afraid of the three eyes.The main reason is that the guy has a dog with him, and the fight is too annoying."Wow!" Sun Wukong was so happy.He jumped three feet high on the spot, and the golden hoop smashed the ground causing sparks to fly."You mortal, you are so rude!" "I have to go in and have a good meal today! Let me see what you can do to me!" After that, Sun Wukong picked up the golden cudgel and smashed it against the invisible wall of air in front of Ye Lin.boom!boom!boom!Every stick carries tremendous power.The entire Nantianmen was trembling.The flowing clouds in the distance were shaken away, and the nearby cranes were so frightened that they lost their feathers.But the invisible barrier in front of Ye Lin didn't even make a ripple.Products produced by the system must be of high quality.Concept-level defense, as long as Ye Lin doesn't let go, let alone Sun Wukong.Even if Tathagata Buddha comes, he still has to fill out the form obediently at the door.Ye Lin sat behind the barrier and drank wolfberry water calmly.He even thought it was noisy, so he took out two cotton balls from his pocket and stuffed them into his ears.It took a full quarter of an hour.Sun Wukong was so tired that he was panting.He was leaning on a golden hoop, bent over, and staring intently at the mortal sitting on the pony.It’s so evil.This mortal has no mana fluctuation at all, but this barrier is as hard as the old man's alchemy furnace."Hey!" Sun Wukong shouted.Ye Lin didn't respond, still looking down at the book.Sun Wukong took a deep breath, channeled enough energy into his Dantian, and roared: "Hey!!!" Ye Lin slowly pulled out the earplugs."What are you doing? Are you tired of smashing? When you are tired, go back and rest. Don't block my sunshine." Sun Wukong felt that his lungs were about to explode.When did he, the mighty Monkey King, ever suffer this kind of injustice?He couldn't get in despite beating him, and he couldn't get in after scolding him.The key is that this kid's attitude of "a dead pig is not afraid of boiling water" is simply more infuriating than the Jade Emperor in the Lingxiao Palace."What do you want?" Sun Wukong gritted his teeth and squeezed out these words from between his teeth."What do I want?" Ye Lin put down the teapot and spread his hands innocently."Mr. Monkey, you're right." "It's hard for me to do it too." "I'm just a temporary worker with a dead salary of several thousand yuan a month... Oh no, a hundred points of hard-earned money." "It depends on the person's face, and we have to prevent complaints." "If you really hit the stick, losing the peach is a small matter, but losing my job is a big deal." Ye Lin sighed, and his tone became serious and thoughtful."Everyone is just here to make a living, so why make things difficult for each other?" "Look at you, you are dressed... majestic, and you look like a big leader at first glance." "For a few peaches, you have to deal with low-level security guards like us. Is it good to spread the news?" "Tomorrow's headlines: Monkey King bullies the weak and beats temporary workers to become disabled." "Do you want this reputation anymore?" Sun Wukong was stunned.He blinked and scratched the golden hair on his head.What this mortal said... seems to make sense?He is now the Monkey King, a god with status.If you really beat this mortal to death, or force your way in, the price will indeed drop a bit.Moreover, this kid talks about "big leader", which is quite pleasant to listen to."Then... my old grandson won't be able to eat peaches?" Sun Wukong was a little unwilling.The scent of peaches penetrated right into his nose, making him want to crawl out."It's not impossible." Ye Lin changed the subject.Sun Wukong's eyes lit up and he put his ears closer."As long as the procedures are complete, I will let you go." Ye Lin took out a crumpled piece of paper from his arms, which was the "Application Form for Admission" he had just drawn out of boredom."Go to the Lingxiao Palace and ask the Jade Emperor to get a seal." "Or ask the Queen Mother to sign it." "If that doesn't work, you can ask that good old man from Taibai Jinxing to write you a note." "As long as there is a note, I will open the door immediately, and even lead the way and help you pick the biggest pick." Ye Lin promised, patting her chest.Sun Wukong's face fell instantly.Looking for the Jade Emperor?Looking for the Queen Mother?If he could pull off this face, why would he come here secretly?"You are amusing me, Sun!" Sun Wukong threw the golden cudgel to the ground.Ye Lin looked upright: "This is the rule! This is the process!" "Without rules, there is no rule." "If everyone comes in with a face like you, then the heaven will be in chaos?" "I am maintaining the rule of law in heaven and contributing to the peace and stability of the three realms!" Ye Lin became more and more excited as he spoke, and his spittle sprayed onto the barrier."Look at me!" He pointed to the crooked red sleeve band on his arm."Who am I? I am the glorious security guard of Pantaoyuan!" "My duty is to guard this door!" "Even if you are the Monkey King, even if you are the King of Heaven, you just can't do it without a note!" These words are very resounding.Sonorous and powerful.Even Sun Wukong was stunned.He looked at the thin mortal, sitting on the old pony, with his back straight and a look of death on his face.Even a little... tragic?This mortal is a bit interesting.Although it is a bit long-winded, although it is a bit pedantic.But this guy's stupidity has a bit of his former self.The fierce light in Sun Wukong's eyes slowly dissipated.He changed the golden cudgel back to the size of an embroidery needle and stuffed it back into his ears.Then.He sat down on the ground opposite Ye Lin.Following Ye Lin's example, he crossed his legs."Okay." Sun Wukong scratched his face, showing a rogue look."You have a point." "I won't go in." "I'll sit here." "I want to see how long you, a mortal, can hold on." Sun Wukong casually pulled a piece of grass from the ground, held it in his mouth, and stared at Ye Lin with a pair of blazing eyes.The two looked at each other for less than a minute, and the lively Sun Wukong couldn't sit still: "Let's talk?" "What to talk about?" Ye Lin guarded his melon seeds vigilantly."Talk about that...labor law you just talked about?" Sun Wukong chuckled."Also, what did you write just now? Show it to me, Old Sun."
